description: Intercity Air, Bus, and Rail Transportation Facilities is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Airports with scheduled service and intercity bus and intercity rail (Amtrak/Alaska rail) facilities for years 2006, 2012, 2018, and 2021. Used to find rural areas with access to one or more of these transportation modes:. Airports with scheduled service and intercity bus and intercity rail (Amtrak/Alaska rail) facilities for years 2006, 2012, 2018, and 2023. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 19 columns, among them the_geom, ruralSrv, cntySrv, hub, servicelvl, AirportCode. The portal shows 2023-10-16 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is See Terms of Use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
